record.field:
Runs Claude Code in one-shot mode as a sub-agent. Exposes a single `claude_code` tool that accepts a natural-language prompt and executes it with full Claude Code capabilities (file edits, bash, git, search, etc.) using --dangerously-skip-permissions.
Repo layout inside the container: /workspace/ordomatics — Ordomatics project root (.git, docker-compose, etc.) /workspace/ordomatics/addons/odoo-llm — odoo-llm submodule (use this for git operations) /workspace/ordomatics/addons/whatsapp — whatsapp submodule (use this for git operations) /mnt/odoo-llm — same data as addons/odoo-llm (Odoo addons path) /mnt/whatsapp — same data as addons/whatsapp (Odoo addons path)
Always pass the relevant working directory in your prompt, e.g. "Your work folder is /workspace/ordomatics/addons/odoo-llm\n\n..."
